patch_list: Skips purchase signature verification and forces billing to report success. Patches RunnerBillingSecurity.verifyPurchase to always return true, Purchase.isAcknowledged/getPurchaseState to return valid values, and the billing bridge callbac…
Simulates the purchase of the 'climbnoads' IAP product by injecting a fake Purchase into the purchase list when the game queries purchases. The game finds 'climbnoads' and treats No Ads as purchased.
